review_kind: Complete Developer Tools install-pointer cluster (439 exact pinned packages), individual 10-dimension static candidate reviews; NOT governed review, security scan or behavioral validation
review_method: Parallel read-only reviewers each assigned disjoint exact package identities with one shared rubric brief; every SKILL.md and package file read in full at the exact pin; one integration owner validated taxonomy, score/rationale consistency, hard-fail/disposition consistency and exact blob/tree identity, then adjudicated conflicts (see reconciliation_overrides). Nothing executed, installed or fetched from candidates.
macro_findings: Every Developer Tools install-pointer card (439, the largest category) was read in full and individually graded; all single-file auto-extracted README pointers. Developer Tools has more real-tool pointers than the ops/security clusters (score mode 9/20), but no card contains an authored task procedure.

53 capability-content mismatches: synthetic wrappers over big repos (terraform, webpack, vite, VS Code, node-postgres "EXPLAIN/HypoPG" analysers, moby Compose cards, an AWS SDK README sold as cloud-cost analysis), wrong install lines (token-savior cloning a benchmark repo, qsv-style mismatches), and empty-description MCP-server cards scoring 0.

24 cards advertise consequential operations without a gate (Coolify/LibreChat/LaunchDarkly/Dockge/Dokku deploys, S3 bulk delete via s5cmd, Wrangler deploys, issue-to-fix-PR automation, GPU job submission); 8 advertise sending code, session memory or private data to hosted LLM/embedding services (claude-context to OpenAI/Zilliz, memanto, stash, caliber, Gemini MCP).
Six remote-code installs (curl|bash, PowerShell irm|iex, cards telling the user to follow whatever upstream currently says) were flagged.
The single REFERENCE-ONLY is delegate-and-resume-repository-tasks-through-pi-bolt-mcp (SHA256SUMS verification, bounded prompt with absolute cwd, no blanket approval); upstream claims unverified.
Batches 4, 6 and 8 were re-run from scratch after a container restart interrupted the first attempt; only complete, validated outputs were integrated.
rubric_calibration_note: Install-pointer brief capped procedural_clarity at 1 (no authored task procedure) and scored most other dimensions 0-1 for pointer cards; some first-pass rationales wrote "/1" or "(max 1)" for this cap and were normalized to the repository 0/1/2 notation on 2026-11-02 without changing scores.
